```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("/home/ozsol/multiomics/src/pipelines/multiomics_pipeline/")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "/home/ozsol/multiomics/src/pipelines/multiomics_pipeline/")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 7,
  dpi = 150
)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(DT)

# Load targets results
targets::tar_load(config)
targets::tar_load(mae_data)
targets::tar_load(integration_results)
targets::tar_load(concordance_results)
targets::tar_load(enrichment_results)
targets::tar_load(mofa_available)
targets::tar_load(diablo_available)
targets::tar_load(snf_available)
targets::tar_load(rp_available)

tryCatch(
  {
    targets::tar_load(commentary_tbl)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    commentary_tbl <<- NULL
  }
)

# Determine availability from params or check objects
mofa_available <- params$mofa_available
if (is.null(mofa_available)) mofa_available <- !is.null(integration_results$mofa)

diablo_available <- params$diablo_available
if (is.null(diablo_available)) diablo_available <- !is.null(integration_results$diablo)

snf_available <- params$snf_available
if (is.null(snf_available)) snf_available <- !is.null(integration_results$snf)

rp_available <- params$rp_available
if (is.null(rp_available)) rp_available <- !is.null(concordance_results$rna_protein)

# Output directory
output_dir <- config$output$output_dir

# Helper function to render commentary for a figure
render_commentary <- function(figure_id, commentary_tbl) {
  if (is.null(commentary_tbl) || nrow(commentary_tbl) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  # Find commentary for this figure
  row <- commentary_tbl[commentary_tbl$figure_id == figure_id, ]

  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    return("")
  }

  # Parse JSON if stored as character
  if (is.character(row$commentary_json) && nchar(row$commentary_json) > 0) {
    tryCatch(
      {
        commentary <- jsonlite::fromJSON(row$commentary_json)
      },
      error = function(e) {
        return("")
      }
    )
  } else {
    return("")
  }

  # Determine if AI-generated or data-driven
  backend <- if (!is.null(row$backend)) row$backend else "none"
  block_class <- if (backend %in% c("claude", "openai")) "ai-generated" else "data-driven"
  title_text <- if (backend %in% c("claude", "openai")) "AI-Generated Commentary" else "Data-Driven Commentary"

  # Build HTML
  html <- paste0('<div class="commentary-block ', block_class, '">\n')
  html <- paste0(html, "<h4>", title_text, "</h4>\n")

  # What is this
  if (!is.null(commentary$what_is_this) && nchar(commentary$what_is_this) > 0) {
    html <- paste0(
      html, '<div class="commentary-what-is-this">',
      htmltools::htmlEscape(commentary$what_is_this), "</div>\n"
    )
  }

  # Observations
  if (!is.null(commentary$observations) && length(commentary$observations) > 0) {
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section">\n')
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section-title">Key Observations</div>\n')
    html <- paste0(html, "<ul>\n")
    for (obs in commentary$observations) {
      html <- paste0(html, "<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(obs), "</li>\n")
    }
    html <- paste0(html, "</ul>\n</div>\n")
  }

  # Issues/checks
  if (!is.null(commentary$issues_checks) && length(commentary$issues_checks) > 0) {
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section commentary-issues">\n')
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section-title">Potential Issues / Checks</div>\n')
    html <- paste0(html, "<ul>\n")
    for (issue in commentary$issues_checks) {
      html <- paste0(html, "<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(issue), "</li>\n")
    }
    html <- paste0(html, "</ul>\n</div>\n")
  }

  # Next steps
  if (!is.null(commentary$next_steps) && length(commentary$next_steps) > 0) {
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section commentary-next-steps">\n')
    html <- paste0(html, '<div class="commentary-section-title">Recommended Next Steps</div>\n')
    html <- paste0(html, "<ul>\n")
    for (step in commentary$next_steps) {
      html <- paste0(html, "<li>", htmltools::htmlEscape(step), "</li>\n")
    }
    html <- paste0(html, "</ul>\n</div>\n")
  }

  html <- paste0(html, "</div>\n")

  return(html)
}
```

# Executive Summary

This report presents the results of multi-omics data integration analysis combining:

```{r summary-omics}
omics_present <- names(mae_data$harmonized_omics)
cat(paste0("- ", omics_present, collapse = "\n"))
```

**Key Statistics:**

- **Total samples analyzed:** `r length(mae_data$common_samples)`
- **Omics layers:** `r length(omics_present)`
- **Condition variable:** `r config$design$condition_column`

}

# Pathway Enrichment

## Per-Omics Enrichment {.tabset}

```{r enrichment-per-omics, results='asis'}
# Get enrichment configuration
enrich_collections <- config$enrichment$collections
top_n_terms <- config$enrichment$top_n_terms %||% c(10, 20, 50)

for (omic in names(mae_data$harmonized_omics)) {
  cat(paste0("\n### ", tools::toTitleCase(omic), " {.tabset}\n\n"))

  # If collections are defined, loop through them
  if (!is.null(enrich_collections) && length(enrich_collections) > 0) {
    for (i in seq_along(enrich_collections)) {
      coll <- enrich_collections[[i]]
      coll_name <- coll$name

      cat(paste0("\n#### ", coll_name, "\n\n"))

      # Check for enrichment files
      enrich_file <- file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(omic, "_", coll_name, "_enrichment.csv"))

      if (file.exists(enrich_file)) {
        # Read enrichment data
        enrich_df <- read.csv(enrich_file)

        # Create interactive plot switcher
        # Find available plot files
        plot_files <- list()
        plot_data_map <- list()

        for (n in top_n_terms) {
          plot_path <- file.path(output_dir, "plots", paste0(omic, "_", coll_name, "_dotplot_top", n, ".png"))
          if (file.exists(plot_path)) {
            plot_files[[as.character(n)]] <- plot_path
            plot_data_map[[as.character(n)]] <- knitr::image_uri(plot_path)
          }
        }

        if (length(plot_files) > 0) {
          # Create unique ID for this plot
          plot_id <- paste0(omic, "_", coll_name)
          clean_plot_id <- gsub("[^a-zA-Z0-9]", "_", plot_id)

          # Default plot (first available)
          default_n <- names(plot_files)[1]
          default_img_uri <- plot_data_map[[default_n]]

          # Dropdown menu
          cat('<div style="margin-bottom: 20px;">\n')
          cat('<label for="', clean_plot_id, '_selector"><strong>Select number of top terms:</strong></label>\n', sep = "")
          cat('<select id="', clean_plot_id, '_selector" onchange="updateEnrichmentPlot_', clean_plot_id, '(this.value)" style="padding: 5px; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid #ccc;">\n', sep = "")

          for (n in names(plot_files)) {
            selected <- if (n == default_n) " selected" else ""
            cat(sprintf('<option value="%s"%s>Top %s terms</option>\n', n, selected, n))
          }

          cat('</select>\n')
          cat('</div>\n\n')

          # Image container
          cat('<div id="', clean_plot_id, '_plot_container">\n', sep = "")
          cat(sprintf('<img id="%s_main_image" src="%s" style="width:100%%; max-width: 900px; height: auto;" alt="Enrichment Plot" />\n', clean_plot_id, default_img_uri))
          cat('</div>\n\n')

          # JavaScript for switcher
          cat('<script>\n')
          cat('var enrichmentImages_', clean_plot_id, ' = ', jsonlite::toJSON(plot_data_map, auto_unbox = TRUE), ';\n\n', sep = "")
          cat('function updateEnrichmentPlot_', clean_plot_id, '(n_top) {\n', sep = "")
          cat('  var img = document.getElementById("', clean_plot_id, '_main_image");\n', sep = "")
          cat('  if (enrichmentImages_', clean_plot_id, ' && enrichmentImages_', clean_plot_id, '[n_top]) {\n', sep = "")
          cat('    img.src = enrichmentImages_', clean_plot_id, '[n_top];\n', sep = "")
          cat('  } else {\n')
          cat('    console.log("Plot not found for n=" + n_top);\n')
          cat('  }\n')
          cat('}\n')
          cat('</script>\n\n')
        } else {
          cat("*No enrichment plots available for this collection.*\n\n")
        }

        # Display table with DT
        if (nrow(enrich_df) > 0) {
          cat("\n**Enrichment Results Table:**\n\n")

          # Select relevant columns
          display_cols <- intersect(
            c("Description", "ID", "term", "GeneRatio", "BgRatio", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "padj", "Count", "overlap"),
            colnames(enrich_df)
          )

          if (length(display_cols) > 0) {
            display_df <- enrich_df[, display_cols]
            print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(display_df,
              caption = paste0(omic, " - ", coll_name, " Enrichment"),
              rownames = FALSE,
              extensions = 'Buttons',
              options = list(
                dom = 'Bfrtip',
                buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
                scrollX = TRUE,
                pageLength = 15
              )) %>% DT::formatSignif(columns = grep("pvalue|padj|p.adjust", colnames(display_df)), digits = 4)))
            cat("\n\n")
          }
        }
      } else {
        cat(sprintf("*No enrichment results found for %s in %s.*\n\n", coll_name, omic))
      }
    }
  } else {
    # Fallback to legacy behavior
    go_file <- file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(omic, "_GO_enrichment.csv"))
    kegg_file <- file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(omic, "_KEGG_enrichment.csv"))
    ora_file <- file.path(output_dir, "tables", paste0(omic, "_ORA_enrichment.csv"))

    if (file.exists(go_file)) {
      cat("\n#### GO Enrichment\n\n")
      enrich_df <- read.csv(go_file)
      if (nrow(enrich_df) > 0) {
        display_cols <- intersect(c("Description", "GeneRatio", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count"), colnames(enrich_df))
        print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(head(enrich_df[, display_cols], 20),
          rownames = FALSE,
          extensions = 'Buttons',
          options = list(
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
            scrollX = TRUE,
            pageLength = 15
          )) %>% DT::formatSignif(columns = grep("pvalue|p.adjust", colnames(enrich_df)), digits = 4)))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }

    if (file.exists(kegg_file)) {
      cat("\n#### KEGG Enrichment\n\n")
      enrich_df <- read.csv(kegg_file)
      if (nrow(enrich_df) > 0) {
        display_cols <- intersect(c("Description", "GeneRatio", "pvalue", "p.adjust", "Count"), colnames(enrich_df))
        print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(head(enrich_df[, display_cols], 20),
          rownames = FALSE,
          extensions = 'Buttons',
          options = list(
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
            scrollX = TRUE,
            pageLength = 15
          )) %>% DT::formatSignif(columns = grep("pvalue|p.adjust", colnames(enrich_df)), digits = 4)))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }

    if (file.exists(ora_file)) {
      cat("\n#### ORA Enrichment\n\n")
      enrich_df <- read.csv(ora_file)
      if (nrow(enrich_df) > 0) {
        display_cols <- intersect(c("term", "overlap", "term_size", "pvalue", "padj"), colnames(enrich_df))
        print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(head(enrich_df[, display_cols], 20),
          rownames = FALSE,
          extensions = 'Buttons',
          options = list(
            dom = 'Bfrtip',
            buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
            scrollX = TRUE,
            pageLength = 15
          )) %>% DT::formatSignif(columns = grep("pvalue|padj", colnames(enrich_df)), digits = 4)))
        cat("\n\n")
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Combined Multi-Omics Enrichment

```{r combined-enrichment}
combined_file <- file.path(output_dir, "tables", "combined_enrichment.csv")
if (file.exists(combined_file)) {
  combined_df <- read.csv(combined_file)

  if (nrow(combined_df) > 0) {
    # Display significant pathways
    sig_combined <- combined_df[combined_df$combined_padj < 0.1, ]

    if (nrow(sig_combined) > 0) {
      display_cols <- c("term", "term_label", "n_omics", "combined_pvalue", "combined_padj")
      display_cols <- intersect(display_cols, colnames(sig_combined))

      # If term_label doesn't exist, use term
      if (!"term_label" %in% display_cols && "term" %in% display_cols) {
        sig_combined$term_label <- sig_combined$term
        display_cols <- c("term_label", "n_omics", "combined_pvalue", "combined_padj")
      }

      print(htmltools::tagList(DT::datatable(sig_combined[, display_cols],
        caption = "Top Combined Multi-Omics Enriched Pathways",
        rownames = FALSE,
        extensions = 'Buttons',
        options = list(
          dom = 'Bfrtip',
          buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
          scrollX = TRUE,
          pageLength = 20
        )) %>% DT::formatSignif(columns = grep("pvalue|padj", colnames(sig_combined)), digits = 4)))
    } else {
      cat("No significantly enriched pathways found across multiple omics (padj < 0.1).\n")
    }

    # Display combined enrichment plot if available
    combined_plot <- file.path(output_dir, "plots", "combined_enrichment.png")
    if (file.exists(combined_plot)) {
      cat("\n\n")
      knitr::include_graphics(combined_plot)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No enrichment results in combined analysis.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Combined enrichment analysis was not performed.\n")
}
```

## Feature Selection Settings

```{r feature-settings}
fs_settings <- list()
for (omic in c("transcriptomics", "proteomics", "metabolomics")) {
  if (!is.null(config$feature_selection[[omic]])) {
    fs <- config$feature_selection[[omic]]
    fs_settings[[omic]] <- data.frame(
      Omics = omic,
      Strategy = fs$strategy %||% "variance",
      Top_N_Variance = fs$top_n_variance %||% NA,
      FDR_Threshold = fs$fdr_threshold %||% NA
    )
  }
}
if (length(fs_settings) > 0) {
  fs_df <- do.call(rbind, fs_settings)
  DT::datatable(fs_df,
    caption = "Feature Selection Settings per Omics",
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = 'Buttons',
    options = list(
      dom = 'Bfrtip',
      buttons = c('copy', 'csv', 'excel', 'pdf', 'print'),
      scrollX = TRUE,
      paging = FALSE
    ))
}
```
